title: AWS Support plans today: Basic to Unified Operations

kcs.statement: Basic Support is free for every account and includes 24/7 account and billing customer service, documentation, re:Post, the Health Dashboard and core Trusted Advisor checks, but no technical support cases.

Business Support+ is the entry paid plan in AWS's current Support lineup, giving 24/7 technical support and a response target of under 30 minutes for critical cases such as a business-critical system being down.
Enterprise Support targets a response in under 15 minutes when a business-critical system is down and includes a designated technical account manager.
Unified Operations is the top Support tier for mission-critical workloads, targeting a response within 5 minutes on critical incidents from an Incident Management Engineer.

problem_ideas: Build the current plan ladder from memory: Basic, Business Support+, Enterprise Support, Unified Operations, each with its critical-response target.
A startup needs 24/7 technical help with a 30-minute target when its checkout is down, at the lowest price: which plan?
A bank needs a response within 15 minutes and one named AWS engineer: which plan?
A trading platform wants an Incident Management Engineer engaged within 5 minutes of a critical outage: which plan?
Spot the false statement: 'Basic Support lets you open technical support cases.'
A hobbyist's account has no paid plan: list three things Basic Support still gives them.
